title: Paginate the widget list endpoint
issue: Add deterministic pagination to `GET /widgets`. `page` is a one-based positive integer that defaults to 1. `limit` is a positive integer that defaults to 2 and may not exceed 3. Return only that page and the metadata `{ items, page, limit, totalItems, totalPages, hasNext }`, preserving the existing item order. A page beyond the final page is valid and returns an empty item list with `hasNext: false`; malformed, non-integer, non-positive, or over-limit query values must receive HTTP 400 instead of silently falling back to defaults.
expectedBehavior: The widget endpoint returns stable one-based pages with defaults, a maximum page size of three, complete pagination metadata, an empty response for pages beyond the end, and a 400 response for invalid query values.
